components.css: .ds-controls{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;padding:4px;background:rgba(23,32,22,.97);border:1px solid rgba(232,221,197,.34);border-radius:18px;color:#e8ddc5;font-family:Epilogue,sans-serif}.ds-controls button,.ds-options summary{min-height:44px;min-width:44px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:12px;background:transparent;color:inherit;border:1px solid transparent;font:600 12px Epilogue,sans-serif;white-space:nowrap}.ds-options summary{display:flex;align-items:center;cursor:pointer;list-style:none}.ds-options summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-controls button:hover,.ds-options summary:hover{background:#293321}.ds-controls button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #e8ddc5;outline-offset:5px}.ds-options summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #e8ddc5;outline-offset:3px}.ds-controls button:disabled{opacity:.65}.ds-panel{position:absolute;bottom:calc(100% + 10px);right:0;width:260px;padding:14px;background:rgba(23,32,22,.98);border:1px solid rgba(232,221,197,.34);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(23,32,22,.2)}.ds-panel button{width:100%;background:#293321;border-color:rgba(232,221,197,.38)}.ds-panel span{display:block;font:12px/1.6 Epilogue,sans-serif;margin-top:10px}

narrative.overview: Owner-approved image and scroll interaction, applied only to a throwaway preview. The canonical Product Launch design record is unchanged. Existing Epilogue and oat lettering remain; the forest background is the selected new material.
keyCharacteristics: Wider reading passages lead on desktop; frosted moss reveals forest atmosphere while the waterfall stays visible to the right.
Camera travel and water-only movement form one continuous scene.
Simulation is explicitly identified; this is not an image-to-video result.
rules: V4 compact201.3125×54px motion bar unchanged; all JavaScript and controls preserved, including Escape/outside/focus dismissal.
V5 desktop: width min(1120px,60vw), padding clamp(32px,3.6vw,56px), body18px,75% moss/24px frost. Mobile V4 geometry and78%/12px retained; text/images/buttons opaque.
Fallback:94% moss/no blur for unsupported backdrop-filter, reduced transparency or increased contrast; unsupported engine branch unverified.
Opaque secondary actions preserve contrast; white-backdrop body bound4.6838:1 desktop and5.1658:1 mobile. Copy and water scripts unchanged; desktop geometry intentionally widened.
Static photograph rendered natively outside transparent water overlay; original image unchanged.
Reduced camera zoom: desktop1.18–1.02; mobile approximately1.074–1.01.
Continuous tier-directed advection; opaque RGB velocity map; landing foam in matte blue channel.
Water canvas budget: native device scale up to DPR3 and8M pixels, within GPU renderbuffer limit.
Photo placement only changes with camera geometry; simulation disclosure and reduced-motion fallback retained.
dos: Do keep simulation/fallback disclosure accessible in Motion options; preserve visible screenshot disclosures.
Do retain normal scrolling, pause, static fallback and reduced-motion behaviour.
donts: Don’t promote this prototype to the homepage without owner review.
